source.source: Kite historical BANKNIFTY index minute candles

methodology.signals: Indicators use completed timeframe bars only
methodology.entriesAndSignalExits: Any bar-close decision fills at the following timeframe bar's first minute open
methodology.stops: Existing stop is replayed minute by minute; adverse gaps fill at minute open
methodology.trailing: Favourable movement from a completed bar can update the stop only for following minutes
methodology.ambiguity: No same-minute favourable ordering is assumed
methodology.positionLimit: One index-equivalent position at a time
methodology.limitation: BANKNIFTY index points, not historical futures contract fills; latest period is chronological but no longer pristine after earlier research iterations
